name: Sylhet

queries.query: Sylhet official cadastral map land records Bangladesh ePorcha mouza map GIS land registry
queries.scope: Find official city land registry/cadastral sources and inspect anonymous map or parcel geometry routes.
queries.result: The official DLRS Map Search is active and has anonymous administrative selectors, but the current Sylhet district survey entry is RS (digital survey, marked ongoing), and its GetThanaListBySurveyMap selector returned an empty list. The inspected selector chain supplies no map-backed upazila/mouza for a city-point geometry query; city-point coverage remains unestablished. The separate national map.land.gov.bd route is land-use zoning rather than a verified cadastral-title layer; its documented GeoServer host returned HTTP 503 over HTTPS. No parcel geometry was retained.
queries.executionMethod: Separate English/local-language search followed by first-party official page review and bounded anonymous service-route inspection where available.

pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Sylhet’s official citizen charter lists land-record and mouza-map services at the district e-service centre and record room in the District Commissioner office, Sylhet. The official Sylhet Sadar land office also describes local mutation/land administration services. This confirms city-located records services, but no map-backed city polygon was returned.
